name: sql-uses-props-warm-step-fresh-emission
body: Step 3 (db.lbug removed, fact store kept) accepts either `[scan] warm cache:` or `[scan] incremental: 0 target file(s)`; the observed route is the incremental one, which still spawns every frontend, and the sql frontend always receives the full tracked .sql set as its --targets list, so its Uses properties arrive on fresh records rather than through splice_cached's restore of cached FragEdge properties. The step therefore proves the SQL rows equal a full scan after that rebuild, not the cached-property restore for sql; the cached-restore route is exercised by the COBOL copy-edge warm reassembly test. Upgrade by asserting `running sql frontend` is absent (or that the warm-cache line appears) if this test must prove cached SQL properties are restored.
